protocol: Equal-density D2Q9 MRT layered slit; viscosity ratio 9:1; no slip; separately measured planar interface; no flow-data fitting.
scaling: Fixed relaxation times, F ~ H^-3 and sigma ~ H^-1. Fixed beta shrinks the physical interface with refinement. This is a coupled sharp-interface/grid sequence, not a fixed-interface convergence study.
scope: Controlled viscous transport only. No capillary-entry, trapping, universal confinement threshold or novel viscosity closure is demonstrated.

analytic_thin_interface_coefficients.small_parameter: xi/H for a centered tanh interface; continuous volume flux
